prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile app concept comp, portrait phone screen
Primary request: Create a polished iPhone-style UI mockup for the ACNH Diary mobile control system, screen 1 of 3: Today quick capture. This is a native mobile app screen, not a landing page. The user is a Korean Animal Crossing: New Horizons player using one hand while playing. Show a NookPhone-inspired but original interface: warm island paper background, leaf green primary controls, museum blue secondary, catalog amber accent, resident coral highlight, dark ink text. Layout: top native safe-area header with island name and date, then a compact quick-capture dock with large 48dp icon buttons for daily routines, then a current-critters strip with fish/bug/sea icon tiles and caught/donated toggles, then a smaller NPC visit row. Use icon-first controls with short Korean labels only where needed. Include visible large tap zones around icons. Use cute game-like item icons and creature thumbnails, allowed to resemble ACNH reference/icon imagery, but do not use Nintendo logos. Text should be minimal and legible: 오늘, 빠른 기록, 지금 출현, 루틴, 기증, 채집, 보유, 주민. Avoid long paragraphs. Avoid generic pastel habit tracker style; make it feel like a private island diary tool. High-fidelity app screenshot, 390x844 logical phone composition, realistic native UI spacing, rounded but not overly bubbly, no marketing hero, no web browser chrome, no watermark.
